task_schema.focus: reduce financial support 与 funding cuts
task_schema.success_criteria: 能保留削减资金这一动作、对象和对研究的影响

back_content.text: 结论：同义替换 = 原意不变，用不同词汇表达；听力中答案常以改写形式出现。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The government announced it would reduce financial support for the program, which means the funding cuts will significantly affect ongoing research projects.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：原句"reduce financial support" 与改写"funding cuts"意思相同，是典型同义替换。② 核心规律：CET6同义替换规律：动词对动词（reduce = cut），名词对名词（financial support = funding），选项中找语义等价而非字面相同的表达。③ 验证与迁移：答案选项通常不含原文词汇，需要建立词汇等价关系图谱。
tips: 同义替换：reduce = cut = decrease = lower；financial support = funding = subsidy。
听力答题核心策略：原文词汇不出现在正确选项中，需要识别语义等价。

back_content.text: 结论：原文"the company terminated the contract"= 选项B "the agreement was ended by the firm"。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The company decided to terminate the contract with the supplier due to repeated delays in delivery and failure to meet quality standards.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：terminate = end/cancel，contract = agreement，company = firm，是三重同义替换。② 核心规律：CET6选项中同义替换通常涉及：动词（terminate→end）、名词（contract→agreement）、主体（company→firm）三层改写。③ 验证与迁移：识别方法：把原文核心词替换为近义词，看哪个选项语义与原文一致。
tips: terminate = end = cancel = discontinue；contract = agreement = deal。
MC正确项不会用原文词汇，换词不换意是CET6听力的核心出题逻辑。

task_schema.success_criteria: 能把长时投入改写为 devotes extensive time，同时保留具体时长证据

back_content.text:
可接受改写：The researcher devotes an exceptionally large amount of time to data analysis, spending over twelve hours on it each day.

不能只写 most of the time，因为该说法丢失具体时长且参照范围不清。
back_content.explanation: 数量信息可以转为程度概括，但高质量改写应保留可核验的 over twelve hours a day。

analysis_content.text:
① 数量证据：more than twelve hours a day 是明确可核验的时长。

② 程度改写：可概括为 devotes an exceptionally large amount of time，但不能无参照地写 most of his time。

③ 事件保持：spends... analyzing data 可改写为 devotes... to data analysis，dedication 仍是由投入时长支持的评价。
tips: 数量改程度时，尽量保留原始数字作证据锚。
同义改写要避免引入参照范围不明的新比例。

back_content.text:
参考改写：Consistent physical activity can markedly enhance memory and cognitive performance among people of any age.

regular→consistent，substantially improve→markedly enhance，individuals of all age groups→people of any age。
back_content.explanation: 改写不只是换单词，还要保留 can 的可能性、改善方向和全年龄适用范围。

analysis_content.text:
① 活动改写：regular physical exercise ≈ consistent physical activity。

② 强度改写：substantially improve ≈ markedly enhance，不能弱化成 may slightly help。

③ 范围改写：individuals of all age groups ≈ people of any age，不能缩成只适用于年轻人。
tips: 同义替换要同时核对语气、程度和范围。
多个词组共同改写时，逐槽对齐比只找一个近义词更可靠。

back_content.text: 结论：原文"the policy was scrapped"= 选项A "the plan was abandoned"。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：After months of heated debate, the government finally decided to scrap the controversial education policy due to widespread public opposition.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：scrap = abandon = cancel = drop；controversial = disputed；opposition = resistance。② 核心规律：同义替换三步法：1）找原文核心动词，2）在选项中找近义动词，3）确认主语/宾语也完成替换。③ 验证与迁移：本题scrap(scrapped) → abandoned 是核心替换；due to public opposition → due to resistance 也是替换线索。
tips: scrap = abandon = cancel = drop = axe（口语）；均表示"放弃/废止"。
同义替换题：先锁定核心动词，再验证主宾语，三者均完成替换=正确答案。

task_schema.action: 听后解释抽象评价的证据
task_schema.focus: resilience 与 bounced back 的语义对应
task_schema.success_criteria: 能用 strong recovery ability 改写韧性，并用快速复苏作为证据

back_content.text: 结论：remarkable resilience = 非凡的韧性 → 同义替换为 exceptional recovery strength 或 impressive ability to recover。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The housing market has shown remarkable resilience in recent months, bouncing back from last year's downturn with surprising speed and vigor.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：remarkable = 非凡、exceptional/impressive/extraordinary 的同义词；resilience = 韧性/恢复力，等同 recovery ability/robustness。② 核心规律：CET6 同义替换：原词常被选项换成较常见近义词，题目不重复原词，而是换表达。③ 验证与迁移：housing market bounced back = recovered；以 resilience/recovering/bouncing back 形容市场 = 同义方向。
tips: resilience = 韧性/恢复力，常替换为 ability to recover / robustness / strength。
remarkable/exceptional/impressive = 程度副词组替换，强调 "非凡" 的表达集群。

task_schema.action: 听后区分改写与因果延伸
task_schema.focus: 数据根本缺陷及其决策可靠性后果
task_schema.success_criteria: 能把 fundamentally flawed 改写为 seriously defective，并说明 unreliable policy decisions 是后果而非同义词

back_content.text:
改写：the data was fundamentally flawed ≈ the data was seriously defective / deeply problematic.

因果后果：基于这些数据的政策决定会不可靠。后者不是 flawed 的同义表达，而是缺陷数据导致的判断风险。
back_content.explanation: 先建立词义等价，再单独标出 consequence，避免把因果关系误记成同义关系。

analysis_content.text:
① 程度与评价：fundamentally flawed ≈ seriously defective / deeply problematic。

② 因果连接：and that any policy decisions based on it would be inherently unreliable 说明缺陷数据的后果。

③ 边界：flawed data 与 unreliable decisions 相关但不等义；一个描述数据质量，一个描述依赖该数据的决策可信度。
tips: 先标 E1≈E2，再标 E1→R，避免混淆等义和因果。
同义替换必须保持被描述对象一致。

task_schema.success_criteria: 能用 serious doubts 或 substantial reservations 改写态度，并说明其质疑内容

back_content.text: 结论：considerable skepticism = 相当大的怀疑 → 同义替换：serious doubt / significant reservations / strong hesitation。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The architect's proposal was met with considerable skepticism by the planning board, who questioned whether the ambitious design was structurally feasible within the given budget constraints.

analysis_content.text:
① 程度：considerable ≈ substantial / significant，表示怀疑程度较强。

② 态度：skepticism ≈ serious doubts / reservations；不能无条件扩大为 pessimism，因为后者是更宽泛的悲观倾向。

③ 质疑对象：委员会怀疑雄心勃勃的设计能否在预算限制内实现结构可行。
tips: 态度词改写要保持对象、方向和强度。
doubt/reservations 比 pessimism 更精确对应 skepticism。

task_schema.action: 四选一：匹配核心主张
task_schema.focus: 强调对象、对照对象与立场方向
task_schema.success_criteria: 选择保留系统偏重记忆并弱化分析创造能力发展的表述

back_content.text: 结论：rote memorization = 死记硬背 → 同义替换：mechanical learning / memorizing without understanding / learning by repetition。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The professor argued that contemporary educational systems prioritize rote memorization over the development of analytical and creative thinking capacities.

analysis_content.text:
① 强调对象：educational systems prioritize rote memorization。

② 对照关系：over the development of analytical and creative thinking capacities 表示前者被优先、后者被压低。

③ 选项核验：B 用 mechanical memorization 和 analytical skills 保留关系；A/C 反向，D 则把教授的批评偷换为支持。
tips: 核心主张改写要保留 A over B 的优先级方向。
同义词匹配之后还要核对说话者立场。

task_schema.action: 听后改写程度强化的负面评价
task_schema.focus: wholly inadequate 的程度与功能失败
task_schema.success_criteria: 能用 entirely ineffective / completely insufficient 改写，并保留监管机制未能应对无证经营扩张

back_content.text: 结论：wholly inadequate = 完全不够用/完全无效 → 同义替换：entirely ineffective / completely insufficient / totally failing to work。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The regulatory agency eventually conceded that its enforcement mechanisms had proven wholly inadequate in addressing the rapid proliferation of unlicensed operators in the market.

analysis_content.text:
① 程度强化：wholly ≈ entirely / completely。

② 负面评价：inadequate 在此表示机制不足以应对问题，可改写为 ineffective / insufficient for the task。

③ 语境边界：失败对象是 enforcement mechanisms，所面对的是 unlicensed operators 的快速增加；不能只写“监管机构不好”。
tips: 程度副词与负面形容词要作为整体改写。
选项不一定出现固定近义词，仍需核对功能和对象。

task_schema.action: 听后改写揭示行为与伦理评价
task_schema.focus: 纪录片揭示、系统剥削与无良雇主
task_schema.success_criteria: 能用 exposed systematic exploitation by unethical employers 改写完整事件

back_content.text: 结论：unscrupulous employers = 无良雇主 → 同义替换：dishonest/exploitative/unethical employers。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The documentary shed light on the systematic exploitation of migrant workers, revealing how their vulnerability was consistently taken advantage of by unscrupulous employers.

analysis_content.text:
① 揭示动作：shed light on ≈ revealed / exposed。

② 行为关系：systematic exploitation 与 vulnerability was consistently taken advantage of 共同说明持续利用弱势。

③ 伦理评价：unscrupulous employers ≈ unethical / unprincipled employers；完整改写必须保留 migrant workers 这一受害群体。
tips: 短语动词、行为和评价词可以同时改写，但事件角色不能交换。
systematic / consistently 体现持续性，不能删成一次性事件。

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再识别 reconciling contradictions 的同义替换，并判断两大理论的关系。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再识别 reconciling contradictions 的同义替换，并判断两大理论的关系。

task_schema.action: 听后改写抽象科学冲突
task_schema.focus: 长期努力、调和表面矛盾与各自适用领域
task_schema.success_criteria: 能说明科学家长期尝试解决两理论间的表面不相容，同时保留二者各自成功

back_content.text: 结论：reconciling contradictions = 调和矛盾 → 同义替换：resolving conflicts / bridging incompatibilities / finding a unified framework。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Scientists have long grappled with the challenge of reconciling the apparent contradictions between quantum mechanics and general relativity, two theories that are each enormously successful in their respective domains.

analysis_content.text:
① 困难投入：grappled with the challenge ≈ struggled with the problem。

② 调和任务：reconciling apparent contradictions ≈ resolving apparent conflicts / bridging seeming incompatibilities。

③ 限定让步：两种理论 each enormously successful in their respective domains；冲突是 apparent，不能改写成任一理论完全错误。
tips: 抽象改写要保留 apparent 等认识论限定。
respective domains 说明各自成功范围，不能删掉后宣称普遍失效。
